fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` that `ping_trig` sent. The official client sends a random string of 5 characters (js/functions.js:230-235).

fields.name: ui
fields.description: The `ui` that `ping_trig` sent. The official client sends `true` when it shows the ping in the log.

confirm.note: The request is echoed as is, so a request that is not an object comes back as that value; a missing one comes back as `{}`.

senders.what: The `ping_trig` handler. It sends back the payload of the request unchanged. A request without a payload gets `{}`.
